statements.text: The guardrails are needed, absolutely regulation is needed, but again, so many of us from impacted communities are so excited about what this technology allows for us to do.
statements.context: Congressional hearing on the federal government in the age of artificial intelligence, where the member discusses AI healthcare benefits and asks an expert witness about data privacy standards.

statements.text: Do we shut down Berkeley’s data centers? I don’t think so. Do we shut down Lawrence labs? No. But what we’ve demanded of (Berkeley Lab) is that they use renewable energy from beginning to end. So if we’re gonna have a technology infrastructure in the Bay Area, it better serve the people, and it better not be extracted. I think reviewing proposals around moratoriums is really important.
statements.venue: Interview with The Daily Californian after town hall, on data centers in Oakland/Berkeley

statements.text: Like many people across the nation, I am concerned about the proliferation of data centers and their impacts on our communities. I will do everything I can to ensure that community voices are at the table and that we are centered in these developments and get the transparency and protections we deserve.
statements.venue: Statement to Bay Area News Group on Oakland data center proposals
